svg.title: White Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Three observed blue regions on white rectangular ground, including lower-left curl and blue pointed area at right. Curves approximate.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ago.ca/events/ellsworth-kelly-curators-talk; source object 62/63; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
